why: MOXIR Minimal — the cut, simple (fixed lights only). The same five cues and timing as the underground loop (scripts/rigbuild/show-loop.mjs MOXIR_MINIMAL_SHOW), named for what the fixed rig does in each. No head moves on the line in this version, so the sway rule (scripts/rigbuild/sway.mjs) has nothing to hold; it is checked all the same.
